description: Minimal search tool following the deep-research search/fetch convention. Returns a ranked list of Swiss court decisions matching a query, each as {id, title, url, snippet}. Pair with `fetch` to retrieve a decision's full text by id. General (non-deep-research) clients should prefer `search_decisions`, which exposes filters (court, canton, date, language) and richer metadata. Relevance-ranked, so not the way to the newest rulings: use search_decisions with sort='date_desc' or published_from, and expect the newest decision dates to trail today, since courts publish weeks to months after deciding.
name: search
title: Search decisions (basic)
